svg.desc: SAVA takes 16 kHz mono audio in 40 ms frames of 640 samples. A causal log-mel front end uses a 400-sample window and 160-sample hop: four hops of 128 mel bins per frame. The frame's log RMS is appended to these 512 features. The current and previous feature rows are concatenated and projected from 1026 to 512 channels, then RMS-normalized. The shared trunk has three Mamba-2 blocks followed by one causal sliding-window attention block and a final RMSNorm. Each block has a pre-normalized mixer and SwiGLU with residual connections. Mamba-2 uses state size 128, head dimension 64, expansion 2 and convolution width 4. Attention uses 8 query heads, 2 key/value heads, head dimension 64, rotary positions, normalized queries and keys, exclusive self attention and a 512-frame window. The speech branch projects to 512 channels, applies causal attention and RMSNorm, then has two linear sigmoid readouts. At emission step t, the released speech output q_t judges frame t-3: a fixed three-frame, 120 ms lookahead. The on-time readout p_t judges frame t. The turn branch receives the shared trunk features concatenated with a learned 64-dimensional embedding of p_(t-1), the previous frame's on-time speech probability. It projects 576 channels to 512, applies causal attention and RMSNorm, and has linear sigmoid readouts for horizons 0, 5, 10 and 20 frames. The displayed end-of-turn probability r_t uses horizon 0 and is on time; it does not wait for the delayed speech verdict. The model has 25.5 million parameters and constant state size per stream.
